tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.knef_bow.l: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Knephmtyti, goddess of Death, this bow commands the power of storms, smiting anyone who dares defy the Goddess’ will with bolts of lightning.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.description:
+1 experience point for each «Moonlight Arrows» hit. 
 +1 experience point for each point of HP healed by «Heaven's Wrath».
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.shot.des: Shoots out %1$ beams of moonlight that track nearest targets and deal %2$s. Each shot drains %3$s%% of the user's HP.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.swim.des: While this ability is active, using the Bow while submerged or under the rain will send you forward with speed %1$s per second, dealing %2$s damage to enemies in your way.
tooltip.relics.knef_bow.ability.storm.de:
Hold Shift while charging and shoot an Arrow into the sky to summon the Eye of the Storm. For %3$s seconds it calls down thunder and rain in a range of %1$s blocks, dealing %2$s damage to targets below and healing %4$s%% of your max HP. Shooting into the ground unleashes a powerful discharge, chaining lightning to nearby enemies.
Cooldown: 30s.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.ronas_swor: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Rhonas, god of War, this blade can decimate entire armies with its corrosive venom.
tooltip.relics.ronas_sword.description:
+1-3 experience points for each «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a slain enemy. 
 25% chance to get +1 experience point for each new «Rhonas' Venom» stack on a target.
Each swiping attack releases a wave of potent venom in a range of %1$s blocks, seeping further into its targets for %2$s seconds and stacking up to %3$s times. Attacking too fast poisons the user instead.
Pressing Shift+RMB with the Fang will create a toxic cloud, poisoning the enemies in a range of %1$s blocks for %2$s seconds. 
Cooldown: %3$s seconds.
tooltip.relics.ronas_sword.ability.anemi: You feel the poison running through your veins, reducing healing from all sources by %1$s%% and lowering your weapon attack speed to %2$s while the blade is in your inventory.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.montu_hamm: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Montu, god of Labor, this hammer is capable of both bringing down mountains and stripping the earth of its treasures.
tooltip.relics.montu_hammer.description:
+1 experience point for every 25 blocks mined with the Hammer. 
 +1 experience point for each block of ore extracted with «Montu's Strike».
tooltip.relics.montu_hammer.ability.slap:
Pressing Shift+RMB on a block will create a shockwave in a radius of %1$s blocks, causing all ores below to spit out onto the surface. 
Cooldown: %2$s seconds.
The power of the God of Labor allows you to tear through the Earth's crust with ease, expanding the mining area up to a radius of %1$sx%1$s. Use Shift + Mouse Wheel to control the Hammer's might.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.seliaset_h: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Seliaset, goddess of Fertility, this horn allows its user to harness the power of Mysr’s desert winds.
tooltip.relics.seliaset_horn.description: +1 experience point for each enemy stunned by «Nature's Rhythm»
tooltip.relics.seliaset_horn.ability.air: Blow into the Horn to unleash a powerful wind current, pushing all enemies away from you within %1$s blocks at a speed of %2$s blocks per second. Holding Shift will reverse the effect, pulling them towards you instead.
tooltip.relics.seliaset_horn.ability.blo:
Unleashes %1$s shockwaves around the caster, sending surrounding enemies flying and slowing them for %3$s seconds. 
Cooldown: %2$s seconds.
One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Knephmtyti, goddess of Death, this eerie flower gives its user the power to control Death itself.
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.description:
+1 experience point for each bone consumed by «Ghostflame Protection».
+1 experience point for each time a «Living Flesh» attacks its target.
+1 experience point for each split by «Unholy Rebirth»
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.ability.undeath: The Rose's unnatural flame protects its owner, using bones of the undead as fuel. You can put bones into the flower's kiln by clicking on it with a stack of bones. While the flame burns, it absorbs %1$s HP of damage per bone, consuming up to %2$s bones and deteriorating at a rate of %3$s bones per minute. While in the Nether, the Rose slowly replenishes its fuel.
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.ability.living_: Any living creature killed by the Rose's owner has a %1$s%% chance to rise again as a lump of undead flesh with %2$s%% of their max HP, exploding in a suffocating cloud upon their inevitable second death.
tooltip.relics.knef_rose.ability.rot_spl: Remains born of the Rose's powers have a %1$s%% chance to continue their life, splitting into up to %3$s smaller lumps each at %2$s%% of the original size.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.seliaset_s: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Seliaset, goddess of Fertility, the Sun nurtures life in both flora and fauna. But be warned - those who dare come close to the light might burn to ash.
tooltip.relics.seliaset_sun.description:
+1 experience point for each crop grown by «Bountiful Light»
+1 experience for each heated block or item by "Unbearable Heat"
tooltip.relics.seliaset_sun.ability.bles: Place the Sun into the world to return it to its true form. While active the Sun every %1$s seconds speeds up the growth of any crops in radius of %3$s blocks. Animals have %2$s%% chance to give birth to twins.
tooltip.relics.seliaset_sun.ability.heat: Within a radius of %3$s blocks, the Sun burns nearby undead, dealing %2$s damage. Items and blocks in small radius beneath the Sun are also heated for up to %1$s seconds.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.ronas_shie: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Rhonas, god of War, this shield can repel any attack, retaliating back with a wave of raging flames.
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.description:
+1 experience point for each point of damage blocked.
+1 experience point for each enemy knocked away with either «Lion's Rebuke» or «Furious Charge»
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.ability.bloc: Raise the shield, blocking %1$s%% of incoming damage and converting it to %3$s hunger damage per point, while reducing movement speed by %2$s%%.
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.ability.rebu: The Shield accumulates blocked damage, charging up to a maximum of %1$s levels at a rate of %2$s damage per level. Press LMB while guarding to release the stored energy, dealing %3$s damage per charge and knocking enemies away.
tooltip.relics.ronas_shield.ability.char: Raise your shield and charge forward for %1$s seconds, knocking away all enemies in your path, dealing %2$s damage and stunning them for %3$s seconds.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.scroll_of_: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Khatinthep, the god of Knowledge, this scroll can elevate the user’s consciousness, imparting ancient secrets of the arcane.
tooltip.relics.scroll_of_truth.descripti:
+1 experience point for each 5 points of vanilla EXP acquired.
+1 experience point for each EXP level spent on enchanting.
tooltip.relics.scroll_of_truth.ability.e: Using the Scroll will open an Enchantment menu, allowing you to select specific enchantments to put on an item at a cost modifier of %1$s%%. Leveling this ability unlocks more powerful enchantments up to level %2$s.
tooltip.relics.scroll_of_truth.ability.p: The Scroll's arcane powers grant you permanent potion effects of level %1$s, indicated by the color of the scroll's seal. Use Shift + Mouse Wheel to change the applied effect.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.montu_glov: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Montu, god of Labor, these gloves hold the secrets of Aurytekh forging, while also allowing the wearer to craft, build, and mine more efficiently.
tooltip.relics.montu_gloves.description:
+1 experience point whenever it saves an item's durability.
+1 experience point whenever it saves item's durability.
Earns relic XP equal to the XP levels you saved after using the forge.
+4 experience points when using a Pocket Smithing Table or Pocket Anvil
tooltip.relics.montu_gloves.ability.glov: Increases the range for attacking enemies and breaking blocks by %1$s blocks and the speed of block destruction by %3$s%%. Items enchantable with Unbreaking consume %2$s%% less durability.
tooltip.relics.montu_gloves.ability.craf:
Upgrade to use an Anvil Pocket Edition! Level up to unlock tools:
Level 2: Pocket Smithing Table
Level 3: Pocket Stoncutter
And finally, level 4: Pocket Workbench! 
Also offers a %1$s%% discount on anvil enchantments and repairs.
tooltip.relics.montu_gloves.ability.smel:
You are a worthy disciple of Montu! 
Upgrade to forge Auritekh tools! Place Nether Star, Netherite Ingot, and Emerald Block to create auritekh ingot. Try to merge two of them with armor or weapons. Will it work with Elytra or a Beacon?
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.hett_feath: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Khatinthep, the god of Knowledge, this quill records all of the user’s experiences, allowing for the accumulated knowledge to be used in battle.
tooltip.relics.hett_feather.description:
+1 experience point for each healed HP.
+10 experience points when creating a mob's book.
+10 experience points when using "Horcrux" ability.
tooltip.relics.hett_feather.ability.life: Each experience point gives you %1$d heart(s) of health.
tooltip.relics.hett_feather.ability.book:
Using this ability on a mob under %2$s health spawns a book that slams shut on it and gives you a charm of %1$s level. When worn, this charm grants strength and luck against the the defeated mob, as well as resistance against it.
Cooldown: %3$s seconds.
tooltip.relics.hett_feather.ability.save: Shift + Right-click on a block, consuming a book from your inventory, to spawn the Book of Rebirth. When you are about to die within %1$d blocks of it, the book instantly teleports you to itself and heals you. Be aware! Enemies can destroy the Book of Rebirth, causing you to lose %2$s%% of your XP and %3$s%% of your health.
tooltip.relics.hett_feather.ability.book: The target’s HP is low enough
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.traveller_: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Being a shard of a Time paradox, this blade allows its wielder to travel vast distances, unbound by laws of time and space.
tooltip.relics.traveller_sword.descripti: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Being a shard of a Time paradox, this blade allows its wielder to travel vast distances, unbound by laws of time and space.
tooltip.relics.traveller_sword.ability.t: It gradually increases movement speed while sprinting. The maximum reaches in %1$s seconds. Gives ability to cut through enemies dealing %2$s%% of the sword damage. Upon reaching maximum speed, the sword swings in a wide arc, dealing %3$s%% of its damage.
tooltip.relics.traveller_sword.ability.d:
You dash forward for %1$s blocks and deal %2$s%% of the sword's damage to all mob in its path and in front.
Cooldown: %3$s seconds.
tooltip.relics.traveller_sword.ability.s:
Within next 20 seconds after each strike, a huge blade appears above your head and smashes all living enemies towards you, dealing %1$s%% of the sword's damage and instantly propelling you to the tip of the sword afterward.
Cooldown: %2$s seconds.
tooltip.relics.leveling_source.generic.t: +%1$s experience points every 2 seconds at maximum speed.
+%1$s experience points whenever you cut through enemies at maximum speed.
tooltip.relics.traveller_sword.leveling_: +%1$s experience points for each activation of %2$s ability.
tooltip.relics.leveling_source.generic.d: +%1$s experience points when you slash through a mob while dashing forward.
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.jodah_staf: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by God-Pharaoh himself, this staff demands absolute perfection from its user in exchange for control over mortal souls, fitting for a god. Only the worthy can awaken the true power of this artifact.
tooltip.relics.jodah_staff.description:
+1 experience point per vanilla experience point lost hitting with Jodah staff.
+2 experience point for each health drain.
+3 experience point for every teleport with "A thousand eyes" ability.
tooltip.relics.jodah_staff.ability.rangi: After several successful hits, the staff’s rank increases from §lD§r to §lS§r. Getting hit decreases the rank by 2. Spend XP to deal more damage. Higher ranks are stronger but consume more XP. The number of hits needed to level up the rank is reduced by %1$s. You spend %3$s%% less XP and deal %2$s%% of your damage with the staff of any rank.
tooltip.relics.jodah_staff.ability.healt:
Within the next %4$s seconds you will drain health and xp from nearest %2$d target(s). The radius of the ability and the amount of drained XP and health depend on your rank. You will gain %3$s%% more XP from this ability.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
tooltip.relics.jodah_staff.ability.one_t:
Upgrade to unlock the ability.
Reveals all living creatures in a large radius. Select a target and right-click to instantly teleport to it, dealing minor area damage. Each target can be teleported to once, and at higher ranks, twice. Strike unexpectedly!
tooltip.relics_thirteenflames.jodah_mask: One of the «Flames», legendary artifacts scattered across the world. Created by Lololowka, one of the First, this mask gives its wearer complete control over their Spark, allowing to wield the powers of both Time and Anti-Time at will.
tooltip.relics.jodah_mask.description:
+3 experience points for every HP haled with Planeshift.
+3 experience points for each activation of "Sparkslip" ability.
Gains as much experience points on "Dark Stat" explosion as big this explosion is.
+1 experience point for each kill with "Skint Genesis".
+1 experience point per mob with Antiscint charge damaged, +1 for every 3 charges.
tooltip.relics.jodah_mask.ability.planes:
The player disappears from the world for %2$s seconds, becoming invisible, immobile, and invulnerable (press Shift to cancel). Heals you a heart for each scint charge consumed.
§fᤁ§r: Gains you 1 scint charge.
§fᤂ§r: Damages nearby mobs, giving them 1 Antiscint charge.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds. §fᤁ§r §fᤂ§r → §fᤀ§r
tooltip.relics.jodah_mask.ability.sparks:
Can only be used while §fᤀ§r.
Teleports you to the point you are looking at within %2$s blocks. Gains you 2 scint charges.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds. §fᤀ§r → §fᤂ§r
tooltip.relics.jodah_mask.ability.dark_s:
Can only be used while §fᤀ§r.
Turns the player into a meteor of size %1$s, flying faster and faster toward the point they are looking at. Larger and faster meteors deal more damage and have a bigger explosion radius.
Cooldown: %2$s seconds. §fᤀ§r → §fᤁ§r
tooltip.relics.jodah_mask.ability.skint_:
Can only be used while §fᤁ§r or §fᤂ§r.
For the next 10 seconds %2$s (+1 per scint charge) scint (§fᤁ§r) or antiscint (§fᤂ§r) clusters will spawn, dealing %1$s damage. When mob is killed it either explodes and grants %3$s antiscint charge(s) nearby (§fᤂ§r) or heals you and gives %3$s scint charge(s) (§fᤁ§r).
Cooldown: %4$s seconds. §fᤁ§r §fᤂ§r → §fᤀ§r
tooltip.relics.jodah_mask.ability.revers:
§lPassive:§r Increases your max scint charges and enemies’ antiscint charges by %1$s. 
§lActive:§r in a large area, swaps scint charges on the caster with antiscint charges on enemies. Can be used while §fᤁ§r or §fᤂ§r.
§fᤁ§r: Deals damage based on absorbed Scint charges
§fᤂ§r: Freezes enemies for 2 seconds per antiscint charge received.
Cooldown: %2$s seconds.
